entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the Petitioner moves the present application pursuant to the NBW issued by the court of Additional Special Judge-cum-Vigilance, Bhubaneswar in T.R. No.47 of 2012.

4. As reveals from the order passed by the learned court below, two of the Petitioners while attended the court, the present Petitioner did not avail the same and preferred not to take step on his behalf.
In that view of the matter, the conduct of the Petitioner cannot be taken so leniently while this court is in seisin over an application under Section 438 Cr.P.C.
As reveals, the case was registered as back as in the year 2009 and the Trial Court sat over the matter in the year 2012.
After a lapse of 10 years when the Petitioner is being asked to appear, he is neither appearing nor taking step showing Biswanath Seula vs State Of Odisha ....
